system.description: When the Abyssal bites a victim, she can pay one Willpower whenever she consumes one or more health levels from him. Doing so sucks out all Sickness effects from a patient's body. The Abyssal must check for normal exposure to all communicable illnesses removed thus. Fortunately, deathknights' inherent immunities to non-magical diseases minimize this danger, making this Charm an excellent way to stock up on plagues to spread to others. Purchasing this Charm also allows the Abyssal to suppress her autonomic immune response to any Sickness effect she carries so that her Essence-infused body does not cleanse it out before she has a chance to use it. Unlike the Sickness effects created by Pestilence-Bearing Touch, these are true infections: The Abyssal can spread them using only their normal vectors.
